The present study of 307 patients with breast cancer revealed germline mutations in 19% of cases. BRCA1/2 genes accounted for 31% of pathogenic mutations, while the ATM gene represented 12%. The high frequency of ATM mutations (12% overall) and its functional similarity to BRCA1/2 suggest it could be considered as BRCA3.
